hook: Your arrest record could soon face zero protection in hiring decisions.

sections.voiceover: Your arrest record could soon face zero protection in hiring decisions.

President Trump signed Executive Order 14281 on April 23, 2025. The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission then submitted a draft final rule on October 6, 2026. Where does this leave your background check?
Except the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission seeks to rescind its 2012 guidance.

Executive Order 14281 eliminates disparate impact liability under the Office of Management and Budget. Employers gain total freedom regarding arrest and conviction records under Title VII. Meritocracy rules every hiring choice.
Check the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission rule today.
